# refer also to script this is from - "~/Desktop/viromelib/flaviLib/scrips/plot_cm_class_by_genus.R"

```{r setup, message=FALSE}
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(scales)

knitr::opts_knit$set(root.dir = "~/Desktop/viromelib/flaviLib")
```

```{r paths}
tsv10 <- "work/07_postproc/260602/best_stalls_10mM_sf0.2.tsv"
tsv01 <- "work/07_postproc/260602/best_stalls_01mM_sf0.2.tsv"
fig_dir <- dirname(tsv10)
MIN_SF       <- 0.2
MIN_GENUS_N  <- 5
```

## Load & tidy

```{r load}
d10 <- read.delim(tsv10, stringsAsFactors = FALSE) %>%
  mutate(condition = "10 mM Mg")
d01 <- read.delim(tsv01, stringsAsFactors = FALSE) %>%
  mutate(condition = "1 mM Mg")

dat <- bind_rows(d10, d01) %>%
  mutate(
    genus = ifelse(is.na(genus) | genus == "", "Unclassified", genus),
    family = ifelse(is.na(family) | family == "", "Unclassified", family),
    cm_class = factor(
      cm_class,
      levels = c("cl1a", "cl1b", "cl2", "cl3", "dumbbell", "unannotated"),
      labels = c("cl1a xrRNA", "cl1b xrRNA", "cl2 xrRNA",
                 "cl3 xrRNA", "Dumbbell", "Unannotated")
    ),
    condition = factor(condition, levels = c("10 mM Mg", "1 mM Mg")),
    treated_sf = as.numeric(treated_sf)
  )

cat("Total stall sites (10 mM):", nrow(d10), "\n")
cat("Total stall sites (1 mM): ", nrow(d01), "\n")
```

## CM class summary

```{r cm_summary}
dat %>%
  count(condition, cm_class) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = condition, values_from = n, values_fill = 0) %>%
  arrange(desc(`10 mM Mg`))
```

## Colour palette

```{r palette}
cm_colors <- c(
  "cl1a xrRNA"  = "#1A5FA8",
  "cl1b xrRNA"  = "#4EA8DE",
  "cl2 xrRNA"   = "#F4A11D",
  "cl3 xrRNA"   = "#D85A30",
  "Dumbbell"    = "#5DAD6F",
  "Unannotated" = "#C8C8C8"
)
```

## Figure 1 — CM class by viral genus

```{r fig_genus_filter}
# keep genera with enough stalls across both conditions
genus_keep <- dat %>%
  count(genus) %>%
  filter(n >= MIN_GENUS_N) %>%
  pull(genus)

genus_order <- dat %>%
  filter(genus %in% genus_keep) %>%
  count(genus) %>%
  arrange(desc(n)) %>%
  pull(genus)

dat_genus <- dat %>%
  filter(genus %in% genus_keep) %>%
  mutate(genus = factor(genus, levels = genus_order))
```

```{r fig1_summarise}
genus_summary <- dat_genus %>%
  count(genus, cm_class, condition) %>%
  complete(genus, cm_class, condition, fill = list(n = 0))
```

```{r fig1_plot, fig.width=14, fig.height=6}
p_genus <- ggplot(genus_summary,
                  aes(x = genus, y = n, fill = cm_class)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", width = 0.75, colour = NA) +
  facet_wrap(~ condition, ncol = 2) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = cm_colors, name = "CM class") +
  scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.05))) +
  labs(
    title    = "Xrn1 stall sites by viral genus and CM class",
    subtitle = paste0("SF \u2265 ", MIN_SF, "  |  10 mM vs 1 mM Mg  |  flaviLib 260602"),
    x        = "Viral genus",
    y        = "Number of stall sites"
  ) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    axis.text.x        = element_text(angle = 40, hjust = 1, size = 10),
    strip.background   = element_rect(fill = "#F0F0F0", colour = NA),
    strip.text         = element_text(face = "bold", size = 11),
    legend.position    = "right",
    legend.key.size    = unit(0.5, "cm"),
    plot.title         = element_text(face = "bold", size = 13),
    plot.subtitle      = element_text(colour = "grey40", size = 10),
    panel.grid.major.y = element_line(colour = "grey90", linewidth = 0.3)
  )

p_genus
```

```{r fig1_save}
ggsave(file.path(fig_dir, "fig1_cm_class_by_genus.pdf"),
       p_genus, width = 14, height = 6)
ggsave(file.path(fig_dir, "fig1_cm_class_by_genus.png"),
       p_genus, width = 14, height = 6, dpi = 300)
message("Saved figure 1")
```

## Figure 2 — CM class by viral family

```{r fig2_plot, fig.width=10, fig.height=6}
family_summary <- dat %>%
  count(family, cm_class, condition) %>%
  complete(family, cm_class, condition, fill = list(n = 0))

family_order <- dat %>%
  count(family) %>%
  arrange(desc(n)) %>%
  pull(family)

family_summary$family <- factor(family_summary$family, levels = family_order)

p_family <- ggplot(family_summary,
                   aes(x = family, y = n, fill = cm_class)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", width = 0.65, colour = NA) +
  facet_wrap(~ condition, ncol = 2) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = cm_colors, name = "CM class") +
  scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.05))) +
  labs(
    title    = "Xrn1 stall sites by viral family and CM class",
    subtitle = paste0("SF \u2265 ", MIN_SF, "  |  10 mM vs 1 mM Mg"),
    x        = "Viral family",
    y        = "Number of stall sites"
  ) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    axis.text.x        = element_text(angle = 30, hjust = 1, size = 11),
    strip.background   = element_rect(fill = "#F0F0F0", colour = NA),
    strip.text         = element_text(face = "bold", size = 11),
    legend.position    = "right",
    legend.key.size    = unit(0.5, "cm"),
    plot.title         = element_text(face = "bold", size = 13),
    plot.subtitle      = element_text(colour = "grey40", size = 10),
    panel.grid.major.y = element_line(colour = "grey90", linewidth = 0.3)
  )

p_family
```

```{r fig2_save}
ggsave(file.path(fig_dir, "fig2_cm_class_by_family.pdf"),
       p_family, width = 10, height = 6)
message("Saved figure 2")
```

## Figure 3 — SF distribution by CM class

```{r fig3_plot, fig.width=10, fig.height=5}
p_sf <- ggplot(dat,
               aes(x = cm_class, y = treated_sf, fill = cm_class)) +
  geom_violin(trim = TRUE, scale = "width", alpha = 0.7, colour = NA) +
  geom_boxplot(width = 0.15, outlier.shape = NA,
               fill = "white", colour = "grey30", linewidth = 0.4) +
  facet_wrap(~ condition, ncol = 2) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = cm_colors, guide = "none") +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 1),
                     breaks = seq(0, 1, 0.2),
                     labels = scales::percent_format(accuracy = 1)) +
  labs(
    title    = "Stall fraction distribution by CM class",
    subtitle = paste0("SF \u2265 ", MIN_SF, "  |  10 mM vs 1 mM Mg"),
    x        = "CM class",
    y        = "Treated stall fraction"
  ) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    axis.text.x        = element_text(angle = 30, hjust = 1, size = 10),
    strip.background   = element_rect(fill = "#F0F0F0", colour = NA),
    strip.text         = element_text(face = "bold", size = 11),
    plot.title         = element_text(face = "bold", size = 13),
    plot.subtitle      = element_text(colour = "grey40", size = 10),
    panel.grid.major.y = element_line(colour = "grey90", linewidth = 0.3)
  )

p_sf
```

```{r fig3_save}
ggsave(file.path(fig_dir, "fig3_sf_by_cm_class.pdf"),
       p_sf, width = 10, height = 5)
message("Saved figure 3")
```

## Figure 4 — Proportion stacked bar (normalised)

Useful for comparing CM class composition across genera regardless of
total stall count per genus.

```{r fig4_plot, fig.width=14, fig.height=6}
p_prop <- ggplot(genus_summary,
                 aes(x = genus, y = n, fill = cm_class)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", position = "fill",
           width = 0.75, colour = NA) +
  facet_wrap(~ condition, ncol = 2) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = cm_colors, name = "CM class") +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = percent_format(accuracy = 1),
                     expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.02))) +
  labs(
    title    = "CM class composition by viral genus (proportional)",
    subtitle = paste0("SF \u2265 ", MIN_SF, "  |  10 mM vs 1 mM Mg"),
    x        = "Viral genus",
    y        = "Proportion of stall sites"
  ) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    axis.text.x        = element_text(angle = 40, hjust = 1, size = 10),
    strip.background   = element_rect(fill = "#F0F0F0", colour = NA),
    strip.text         = element_text(face = "bold", size = 11),
    legend.position    = "right",
    legend.key.size    = unit(0.5, "cm"),
    plot.title         = element_text(face = "bold", size = 13),
    plot.subtitle      = element_text(colour = "grey40", size = 10),
    panel.grid.major.y = element_line(colour = "grey90", linewidth = 0.3)
  )

p_prop
```

```{r fig4_save}
ggsave(file.path(fig_dir, "fig4_cm_class_proportion_by_genus.pdf"),
       p_prop, width = 14, height = 6)
message("Saved figure 4")
```
